entries.claim: The new 'Names changes' route in section 1 tells Seldon to Edit the PRD after the user answers its confirm question. It also sends Seldon to 'The PRD draft' for how to quote, and that section still says 'Only a `/seldon prd` rerun changes a PRD that's there', so for the PRD the two instructions contradict each other.
entries.failure_scenario: The PRD step ends on the new confirm question. The user replies `/seldon make PLOT-01 cover plot sizes too`. Section 1's 'Step confirm answered' / 'Names changes' route says to Edit .planning/seldon/prd.md and quote the new words as 'The PRD draft' says. That section (lines 397-403) says a PRD already on disk changes only in a `/seldon prd` rerun, and that otherwise Seldon writes nothing and ends on the later-release line. This turn is not a rerun, so a model that follows section 13 drops the requested change and prints 'The spine and epics steps come in a later release...'. No case exercises the changes path (confirm-clear covers only the confirm answer), so the plan's runs cannot catch this.
